UIbasic — Basic Persistent User Interface Protocol — v1.0 MODULES

UI-TINY Minimal persistent project/function/status view.

UI-COMPACT Normal working status, progress, blocker and next-step view.

UI-FULL Complete project control, pipeline, QA, artifact and
next-actions view.

UI-AUTO Context-aware automatic selection of TINY, COMPACT or FULL.

STATE Canonical state handling and truthful execution status.

PROGRESS Measurable stage/overall progress reporting without invented
percentages.

PERSISTENCE UI preference and valid task/project state restoration.

NEXT State-aware recommended/optional/input-required/auto-continuation
actions.

RECOVERY Failure, blocker, retry and recovery presentation.

ADAPTER Maps UIbasic onto the host application’s existing
state/functions rather than duplicating them.

QA Validation and regression gate before post-update packaging.
